disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部源码与脚本，检查了 .credentials.yaml、~/.ssh、id_rsa、.aws/credentials 等敏感路径的引用，以及 API 密钥、TOKEN、助记词等正则模式，零命中。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code and scripts, checking references to sensitive paths such as .credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh, id_rsa, and .aws/credentials, as well as regex patterns for API keys, TOKENs, mnemonic phrases, etc. Zero hits.

checked_items.zh: 检查了客户端与宿主两侧代码是否存在凭据枚举或云基础设施探测命令，未发现此类行为。
checked_items.en: Checked both client-side and host-side code for credential enumeration or cloud infrastructure probing commands; no such behavior found.

evidence.zh: 未在源码中发现读取凭据文件（如 .credentials.yaml、~/.ssh、云凭据）或遍历密钥的代码；扫描覆盖宿主与客户端两侧源码及脚本，零命中。
evidence.en: No code reading credential files (e.g., .credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh, cloud credentials) or iterating over keys was found in the source; the scan covered both host-side and client-side source code and scripts, with zero hits.

checked_items.zh: 插件未注册任何供模型调用的工具，也未向系统提示注入内容；唯一面向用户的界面文本是斜杠命令（/context）的候选描述与插件 UI 翻译文案，均为常规功能说明，不含指令注入或诱导性措辞。
checked_items.en: The plugin registers no tools for model invocation and does not inject content into the system prompt; the only user-facing interface texts are the candidate description for the slash command (/context) and plugin UI translation strings, both of which are routine functional descriptions and contain no instruction injection or inducing wording.

checked_items.zh: 通读了仓库说明文档、开发指引（AGENTS.md）、设计文档与研究笔记，逐条检查了 '忽略指令'、伪装系统消息、远程拉取指令等注入模式，零命中。
checked_items.en: Read through the repository README, development guide (AGENTS.md), design documents, and research notes, checking each item for injection patterns such as 'ignore instructions', disguised system messages, and remote instruction fetching. Zero hits.

evidence.zh: 插件不注册任何模型可见工具，也没有向系统提示注入片段；唯一面向用户的是 /context 命令，其候选描述为普通功能文案（src/client/i18n.ts），不含系统指令或诱导读取凭据的措辞。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no model-visible tools and injects no snippets into the system prompt; the only user-facing element is the /context command, whose candidate description is plain functional text (src/client/i18n.ts) containing no system directives or wording that induces credential reading.

evidence.zh: 未发现任何工具描述或文档诱导执行安装命令、改写配置或放开权限；仓库文档为正常开发/使用说明。
evidence.en: No tool description or documentation was found that induces execution of install commands, modification of configuration, or permission escalation; the repository documentation is normal development/usage instructions.

checked_items.zh: 在发布代码中未发现 eval、动态构造函数（new Function）、子进程执行（child_process）等危险调用；相关模式只在测试辅助代码中出现（用于在 Node 测试环境按浏览器方式运行打包产物），不随插件发布。
checked_items.en: No dangerous calls such as eval, dynamic constructors (new Function), or child process execution (child_process) were found in the release code; such patterns appear only in test helper code (used to run the bundled artifact in a browser-like manner within the Node test environment) and are not shipped with the plugin.

checked_items.zh: package.json 无安装钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare）；补丁文件仅追加本插件自身的一行声明，不含可执行 JS 表达式（!!js）；未发现混淆代码或动态解码执行模式。
checked_items.en: package.json has no install hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare); the patch file only appends a single line declaring the plugin itself, without executable JS expressions (!!js); no obfuscated code or dynamic decode-and-execute patterns were found.

checked_items.zh: 客户端包声明了浏览器端加载（dsh.client），专项检查键盘监听仅用于弹窗按 Esc 关闭（src/client/components/contextModal.tsx），未记录按键内容；未发现剪贴板、凭据 RPC 调用或异常外联。
checked_items.en: The client package declares browser-side loading (dsh.client). A dedicated check confirmed the only keyboard listener is used to close the popup on Esc (src/client/components/contextModal.tsx) and does not record keystrokes; no clipboard access, credential RPC calls, or abnormal outbound connections were found.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件 cordis.patch.yml 仅含一行 insert 声明，不含可执行 JS 表达式；仓库内其他 YAML 中出现的 !!js 字样均位于研究笔记文档（docs/research/），是介绍 dsh 宿主机制的说明文字，不是插件补丁内容。
evidence.en: The patch file cordis.patch.yml contains only a single insert declaration with no executable JS expressions; occurrences of !!js in other YAML files within the repository reside only in research note documents (docs/research/), which are descriptive text about the dsh host mechanism, not plugin patch content.

evidence.zh: 未发现对动态执行工具（如 cordis_define / cordis_run）的任何调用。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic execution tools (such as cordis_define / cordis_run) were found.

evidence.zh: package.json 无安装钩子；无 git 依赖（不存在未锁定提交的引用）；仓库无 husky/lefthook/devcontainer/Makefile 等树内执行载体；GitHub 发布工作流仅用于作者向 npm 发布（在 GitHub 基础设施上运行，不随插件安装到用户环境）。
evidence.en: package.json has no install hooks; no git dependencies (no references to unpinned commits); no in-tree execution carriers such as husky/lefthook/devcontainer/Makefile; the GitHub release workflow is solely for the author to publish to npm (runs on GitHub infrastructure and is not installed into the user's environment with the plugin).

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端包（dsh.client），已对其专项检查：唯一的键盘监听用于弹窗 Esc 关闭（src/client/components/contextModal.tsx），不记录按键内容；未发现剪贴板读取、凭据 RPC 调用或键盘记录行为。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser-side package (dsh.client) and has been checked specifically: the only keyboard listener is for closing the popup on Esc (src/client/components/contextModal.tsx) and does not record keystrokes; no clipboard reading, credential RPC calls, or keylogging behavior was found.

checked_items.zh: 枚举了全部网络请求目标：客户端仅有一个向 npm 官方仓库（registry.npmjs.org）查询本插件最新版本号的请求（src/client/latestVersion.ts），用于插件信息卡片显示升级提示，1 小时缓存、失败静默降级、不含任何敏感数据，已在能力声明中如实标注网络能力。
checked_items.en: Enumerated all network request targets: the client has only one request to the official npm registry (registry.npmjs.org) to query the latest version of this plugin (src/client/latestVersion.ts), used to display an upgrade hint on the plugin info card. It has a 1-hour cache, fails silently, carries no sensitive data, and the network capability is truthfully declared in the capability statements.

checked_items.zh: 未发现读取敏感信息后外发的链路，也未发现向未知/裸 IP 端点发起的连接、隧道或带外通道。
checked_items.en: No chain that reads sensitive information and then exfiltrates it was found, nor any connection to unknown/raw IP endpoints, tunnels, or out-of-band channels.

evidence.zh: 客户端唯一外联为向 npm 官方仓库查询本插件最新版本（src/client/latestVersion.ts），用于升级提示，不含敏感数据；未发现读取凭据后外发的链路，也未发现对未知端点的连接。
evidence.en: The client's only outbound connection is a query to the official npm registry for the latest version of this plugin (src/client/latestVersion.ts), used for upgrade hints and carrying no sensitive data; no chain reading credentials and then exfiltrating was found, and no connection to unknown endpoints was found.

checked_items.zh: 核对了插件身份：包名、仓库与作者一致，无仿冒同名包迹象；依赖均为官方与常见公开包（@deepseek-ai/cordis、zod、react 等），无 git 依赖（不存在未锁定提交的引用），无安装期执行钩子。
checked_items.en: Verified the plugin identity: package name, repository, and author are consistent, with no signs of a counterfeit same-name package; dependencies are all official and common public packages (@deepseek-ai/cordis, zod, react, etc.), with no git dependencies (no references to unpinned commits) and no install-time execution hooks.

checked_items.zh: 补丁层仅插入自身条目，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，未禁用任何安全行，也未改写注入或拦截配置；未发现对安全事件的优先监听。
checked_items.en: The patch layer only inserts its own entry, does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, disables no security lines, and does not rewrite injection or interception configurations; no prioritized listening on security events was found.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件只插入自身条目（cordis.patch.yml），未覆盖或禁用沙箱/审批/权限等安全配置行。
evidence.en: The patch file only inserts its own entry (cordis.patch.yml) and does not override or disable security configuration lines such as sandbox/approval/permissions.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何工具，也不监听审批类安全事件，不存在截断审批链的优先监听。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools and does not listen to approval-type security events, so there is no prioritized listener that could truncate the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 本次为首次审计，无上一版本基线可比较，无法检测升级自动激活类变化。
evidence.en: This is the first audit; there is no previous version baseline for comparison, so changes involving auto-activation on upgrade could not be detected.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件未改写注入或拦截配置，未给安全插件追加服务。
evidence.en: The patch file does not rewrite injection or interception configurations and does not append services to security plugins.

checked_items.zh: 插件不启动任何本地 Web 服务、不监听端口，运行时不引入额外的本机无认证接口面；动态沙箱未启用（本次未做动态验证），运行时结论基于静态分析。
checked_items.en: The plugin starts no local web service, listens on no port, and does not introduce an additional unauthenticated local interface surface at runtime; the dynamic sandbox was not enabled (no dynamic verification performed this time), so runtime conclusions are based on static analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动本地 Web 服务、不监听端口，不新增本机无认证接口面；该场景针对启动服务的插件，本插件不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a local web service, listens on no port, and adds no unauthenticated local interface; this scenario targets plugins that start services, so it is not applicable to this plugin.

summary.zh: 插件身份与声明核验一致：包名/仓库/作者匹配，清单（package.json 的 dsh 声明与补丁文件）结构合法，无名称仿冒迹象。
summary.en: Plugin identity matches its declarations: package name/repository/author are consistent, the manifest structure (dsh declaration in package.json and the patch file) is valid, and no signs of name impersonation were found.

summary.zh: 静态扫描 29 条规则、79 个文件，命中 11 条（见审计范围说明中的逐条裁决），经人工复核全部为文档说明、测试辅助代码或良性界面行为，未构成风险。
summary.en: Static scan covered 29 rules and 79 files, with 11 hits (see per-item adjudications in the audit scope notes). After manual review, all are documentation, test helper code, or benign UI behavior and pose no risk.

summary.zh: 未发现安装钩子、混淆载荷、凭据读取或异常外联；唯一外联为 npm 官方仓库的版本检查（良性，已如实标注能力声明）。
summary.en: No install hooks, obfuscated payloads, credential reading, or abnormal outbound connections were found; the only outbound connection is a version check to the official npm registry (benign, truthfully declared in capability statements).

summary.zh: 插件无模型可见工具描述与系统提示注入面；文档与命令文案未发现注入措辞。
summary.en: The plugin has no model-visible tool descriptions and no system prompt injection surface; no injection wording was found in documentation or command texts.

summary.zh: 本次未做动态沙箱验证（无动态观测产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed this time (no dynamic observation artifacts).

limits.zh:
插件清单（package.json 的 dsh 字段）未显式声明能力字段，报告中的能力声明按代码实测填写：网络能力为 true（存在向 npm 官方仓库的版本检查请求），其余能力为 false。

点前缀文件（.github、.oxlintrc.json）无法被审计工具直接读取，相关命中裁决依据静态预扫摘录。

动态沙箱未启用（L4 = na），未做运行态验证。

静态预扫 11 条命中全部逐条裁决（规则 ID 见各条）：
(1) DG-R3-59 (DSH-X07)：.github/workflows/release.yml 为作者向 npm 发布用的 CI 工作流（OIDC），在 GitHub 基础设施运行、不随插件安装执行，属常规工程实践，排除。
(2) DG-R4-53 (DSH-C05)：.oxlintrc.json 中 object-curly-spacing 代码风格规则被 curl 模式误匹配，非外发行为，排除。
(3) DG-R3-51 (DSH-P01) 三处：docs/research/ 中介绍 dsh 宿主 !!js 机制的研究笔记，非插件补丁内容（插件自身 cordis.patch.yml 无 !!js），排除。
(4) DG-R3-55 (DSH-X03) 文档一处：同上研究笔记描述宿主加载器的 new Function，排除。
(5) DG-R3-57 (DSH-X05)：src/client/components/contextModal.tsx 键盘监听仅为弹窗按 Esc 关闭，不记录按键，排除。
(6) DG-R3-55 (DSH-X03) 测试四处：tests/ 下用 new Function(bundle)() 在测试环境按浏览器方式运行打包产物，属测试辅助代码、不随发布文件打包，排除。

插件兼容性基于静态兼容层代码（compat.ts）和开发文档声明，未做运行态验证。
limits.en:
The plugin manifest (dsh field in package.json) does not explicitly declare capability fields; the capability statements in this report are filled based on code inspection: network capability is true (there is a version-check request to the official npm registry), all other capabilities are false.

Dot-prefix files (.github, .oxlintrc.json) cannot be read directly by the audit tool; related hit adjudications are based on excerpts from the static pre-scan.

The dynamic sandbox was not enabled (L4 = na), so no runtime verification was performed.

All 11 static pre-scan hits were adjudicated one by one (rule IDs per item):
(1) DG-R3-59 (DSH-X07): .github/workflows/release.yml is a CI workflow for the author to publish to npm (OIDC), runs on GitHub infrastructure, and is not executed during plugin installation; it is routine engineering practice, excluded.
(2) DG-R4-53 (DSH-C05): the object-curly-spacing code style rule in .oxlintrc.json was falsely matched by the curl pattern; it is not an outbound behavior, excluded.
(3) DG-R3-51 (DSH-P01) three occurrences: docs/research/ research notes describing the dsh host !!js mechanism, not plugin patch content (the plugin's own cordis.patch.yml has no !!js), excluded.
(4) DG-R3-55 (DSH-X03) one documentation occurrence: same research notes describing the host loader's new Function, excluded.
(5) DG-R3-57 (DSH-X05): the keyboard listener in src/client/components/contextModal.tsx is solely for closing the popup on Esc and does not record keystrokes, excluded.
(6) DG-R3-55 (DSH-X03) four test occurrences: tests/ use new Function(bundle)() to run the bundled artifact in a browser-like manner in the test environment; these are test helper code and are not packaged in the release files, excluded.

Plugin compatibility is based on static compatibility layer code (compat.ts) and development documentation declarations; no runtime verification was performed.
